findings.message: False claim about the existing code: design.md Context states "LOCATIONS_SCHEMA_VERSION = 2 (constants/storage.ts)" and task 1.1 says "change LOCATIONS_SCHEMA_VERSION to 3 in constants/storage.ts", but packages/client/src/constants/storage.ts contains only STORAGE_AVAILABILITY_PROBE_KEY, STORAGE_KEYS and LOCATIONS_SYNC_CHANNEL_NAME. The constant is defined in packages/client/src/constants/locations.ts:2 (`export const LOCATIONS_SCHEMA_VERSION = 2;`) and is already exported from constants/index.ts. Fix the path in task 1.1 and in the design Context.

Test placed in jsdom although it needs a real browser: task 7.1 puts "System follows a change of the system preference" ("a matchMedia stub that fires change") and "Light on a dark system" in the unit feature settings_preferences_unit.feature. Under design D7 the System theme removes data-theme and relies on the CSS rule `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { :root:not([data-theme="light"]) ... }`, and no code listens to matchMedia. jsdom applies no media queries, so the stub changes nothing observable and the scenario's outcome ("the page uses the dark token values") cannot be verified. .claude/rules/bdd-unit.md "When to Use Unit BDD vs E2E BDD" marks "Responsive layout" and "CSS animations, transitions" as Unit BDD "no", E2E "yes". Move these scenarios into settings_e2e.feature (task 8.2), using Playwright emulateMedia and checking computed token colours.

findings.message: tasks.md 7.1 puts the scenario "Choices survive a reload" into the jsdom unit feature test/features/settings/settings_preferences_unit.feature, but in specs/settings/spec.md that scenario ends with "AND the main page uses the dark token values from its first render". design.md D7 says "jsdom applies neither media queries nor the token CSS, so unit tests only assert the data-theme attribute. Every scenario about token colours ... runs in Playwright", and the acceptance criterion requires "real-browser behaviour in E2E, not in jsdom". Task 7.1 already moves the other token-value scenarios out of the unit feature for that reason but keeps this one, and task 8.2 also defines a scenario of the same name in settings_e2e.feature. Remove it from 7.1, or give the unit version steps that only assert the restored choices and data-theme.

proposal.md says the change removes "15" Here-entry requirements (What Changes: "REMOVED `locations` \"Here entry …\" (15 requirements)"; Capabilities: "REMOVED the 15 \"Here entry\" requirements"). openspec/specs/locations/spec.md has 14 such requirements (lines 945-1210), and the REMOVED section of specs/locations/spec.md removes those 14. The claim about the existing specs is wrong and the Capabilities section does not match the spec file: correct the count to 14.
